summary: The coordinate rings of a zone polygon, in GeoJSON [longitude, latitude] order.
range: Nested arrays of [lon, lat] pairs forming closed rings. NOTE: lon/lat order (opposite of locations.location).
constraints: Each position is [longitude, latitude] (GeoJSON), not "lat, lon".
Rings must be closed (first point == last).
businessRules: coordinates defines: An array of coordinates in the \[longitude, latitude\] format, representing the zone boundary.
Each element in coordinates must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: zones.geometry.type. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: a valid closed square ring.
Gotcha: authoring [lat, lon] here (wrong order) places the zone incorrectly.
